_readme: EVENTS — this file controls the Events page and the events
preview on the home page. You do not need to touch any HTML.
TO ADD AN EVENT: copy one whole block between { and }, paste it
inside the square brackets below, and edit the values. Put a comma
after every block EXCEPT the last one. That trailing comma is the
single most common mistake — if the page shows an error, look there
first.
TO REMOVE AN EVENT: delete its whole block, and check the commas.
YOU DO NOT NEED TO SORT ANYTHING. The website compares each event's
finish time with the current time and files it under Upcoming or
Past automatically. Old events move across on their own.
FIELD BY FIELD:
id        A short unique nickname. Lower case, hyphens, no spaces.
title     The event name as it should appear.
status    'planned'   -> shows a gold PLANNED badge (dates may move)
'confirmed' -> shows no badge (room and date are locked)
start     Date and time it begins. See the format note below.
end       Date and time it ends. Leave as "" if unknown.
location  Building and room, or the city for off-campus events.
format    e.g. 'In person', 'In person + Zoom', 'Virtual'.
committee Which committee runs it. Shows as a small grey label.
summary   One or two sentences. Plain text only, no HTML.
rsvpUrl   Link to a sign-up form. Leave as "" for no button.
1:00 PM California time. The last part is the time zone: use -07:00
for dates in Pacific DAYLIGHT time (roughly March to November) and
-08:00 for dates in Pacific STANDARD time (roughly November to
March). If you only know the day and not the time, you may write
just "2027-05-21" and no time will be displayed.
